public_health_question.v: What were the characteristics of a suspected trichinellosis outbreak linked to undercooked bear meat served at a gathering in western North Carolina?

ev.q: In November 2023, a presumed outbreak of trichinellosis occurred in western North Carolina, resulting in 10 probable cases.
Suspected Outbreak of Trichinellosis Associated with Undercooked Bear Meat
Suspected Outbreak of Trichinellosis Associated with Undercooked Bear Meat — North Carolina, November 2023
Data from attendees and medical records from patients were collected and analyzed to guide public health actions.
the North Carolina Division of Public Health was alerted to a suspected case of trichinellosis in western North Carolina.

equity.level_reason: Age appears only as a descriptor of the cases (median age, cases aged ≤18 years); no other SPD and no equity framing. Treatment cost is mentioned but not tied to social position.

ev.q: Six probable trichinellosis cases occurred among persons aged ≤18 years.

notes: An attack rate among exposed attendees (10/22) is reported, but no comparison with unexposed attendees, so the report is read as a descriptive case series (limited). The median incubation period is described but not compared or interpreted, so continuous is not added. Antibody testing only bears on case status.
